$comment: RAAST Arabic (ar) language profile. Consumed by the raast CLI prose rules and referenced by skills/rtl-typography. Reviewed against standard Modern Standard Arabic web conventions; native-speaker review tracked in docs/implementation-roadmap.md v0.5.
name: Arabic

numerals.unicode_range_note: U+0660-U+0669 (Arabic-Indic digits). Some regional conventions use Western digits; keep profile override per project when needed.

letters.zwnj: rare in Arabic — do NOT apply Persian affix joining rules to Arabic content

dates.months_note: Use Intl month names; month sets differ by locale variant (ar-SA vs ar-EG).

currency.name: ريال سعودي / جنيه مصري — project-specific
currency.placement: project-specific; isolate currency codes (SAR 99) as LTR atoms

bidi_marks.notes: Phones/emails/URLs/serials inside prose must be isolated; never strip U+200E/U+200F marks.
